nodes.long_description:
Xombies es un shooter de oleadas de zombies con tower defense, para quienes creen que la mejor defensa es un buen muro y una escopeta mejor. El mundo es blanco, los muertos son rojos y tú eres lo único entre ellos y la cena.

PELEA
- Pistola, revólver, rifle, escopeta, recortada y bate, con peso y retroceso de verdad.
- Disparos a la cabeza, piernas destrozadas y extremidades que salen volando. Los zombies se lo toman personal.
- Llena tu Furia, mantén los dos gatillos y conviértete en un problema: doble de daño y puños que jubilan zombies.

CONSTRUYE
- Entre oleadas, coloca paredes, barricadas, suelos, minas y torretas con el menú de tu mano izquierda.
- Mejora y repara con el dinero de cada muerte. El crimen no paga, los tiros a la cabeza sí.
- Los zombies rompen lo que estorba y trepan bordes y unos sobre otros como una pirámide humana maleducada. Vigila los bordes.

SOBREVIVE
- Campaña de 4 niveles, cada uno con su jefe (todos se saltaron el día de pierna): protege un generador, aguanta un apagón con linterna y termina con un salto a la oscuridad.
- Modo Infinito con récords en línea. ¿Cuánto aguantarás?
- Fácil, Normal y Difícil. Si te confías, la horda empieza a rodearte.
- Explosivos que hay que parar antes de que te abracen y escupidores sin modales.
- Oleadas especiales, potenciadores, un arma nueva tras cada oleada y 15 logros.

COMODIDAD
Movimiento suave, viñeta de confort, giro por saltos o suave.

Acceso anticipado: habrá contenido nuevo.

nodes.long_description:
Xombies é um shooter de ondas de zumbis com tower defense, para quem acredita que a melhor defesa é um bom muro e uma escopeta melhor ainda. O mundo é branco, os mortos são vermelhos e você é a única coisa entre eles e o jantar.

LUTE
- Pistola, revólver, rifle, escopeta, cano serrado e taco, com peso e recuo de verdade.
- Tiros na cabeça, pernas destruídas e membros que saem voando. Os zumbis levam para o pessoal.
- Encha sua Fúria, segure os dois gatilhos e vire um problema: dano em dobro e socos que aposentam zumbis.

CONSTRUA
- Entre as ondas, coloque paredes, barricadas, pisos, minas e torretas pelo menu da mão esquerda.
- Melhore e conserte com o dinheiro de cada abate. O crime não compensa, tiro na cabeça sim.
- Os zumbis quebram o que estiver no caminho e escalam bordas e uns aos outros como uma pirâmide humana mal-educada. Vigie as bordas.

SOBREVIVA
- Campanha de 4 níveis, cada um com seu chefe (todos pularam o dia de perna): proteja um gerador, aguente um apagão com lanterna e termine com um salto na escuridão.
- Modo Infinito com rankings online. Quanto tempo você aguenta?
- Fácil, Normal e Difícil. Se ficar confortável, a horda começa a te cercar.
- Explosivos que você deve parar antes que te abracem e cuspidores sem modos.
- Ondas especiais, power-ups, uma arma nova após cada onda e 15 conquistas.

CONFORTO
Movimento suave, vinheta de conforto, giro por salto ou suave.

Acesso antecipado: novos conteúdos chegam em atualizações.

nodes.long_description:
Xombies is a zombie wave shooter with tower defense, for people who believe the best defense is a good wall and a better shotgun. The world is white, the undead are red, and you are the only thing between them and dinner.

FIGHT
- Pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun, sawed-off and a baseball bat, with real weight and recoil.
- Headshots, crippled legs and limbs that come off. The zombies take it personally.
- Fill your Fury meter, hold both triggers and become a problem: double damage and fists that send zombies into early retirement.

BUILD
- Between waves, place walls, barricades, floors, mines and turrets from the menu on your left hand.
- Upgrade and repair with cash from kills and combos. Crime does not pay, but headshots do.
- Zombies smash what blocks them and climb ledges and each other like a very rude human pyramid. Guard the edges.

SURVIVE
- A 4-level campaign, each with its own boss (they all skipped leg day): protect a generator, survive a blackout with a headlamp, and end it all with a jump into the dark.
- Endless mode with online leaderboards. How long can you last?
- Easy, Normal and Hard. Get too comfortable and the horde starts flanking you.
- Exploders you should stop before they hug you, and spitters who never learned manners.
- Special waves, power-ups, a new weapon after every wave and 15 achievements.

COMFORT
Smooth movement, comfort vignette, snap or smooth turning.

Early Access: new content arrives in regular updates.

nodes.long_description:
Xombies is a zombie wave shooter with tower defense, for people who believe the best defense is a good wall and a better shotgun. The world is white, the undead are red, and you are the only thing between them and dinner.

FIGHT
- Pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun, sawed-off and a baseball bat, all with real weight and recoil.
- Headshots, crippled legs and limbs that come off. The zombies take it personally.
- Fill your Fury meter, hold both triggers and become a problem: double damage, extra speed and fists that send zombies into early retirement.

BUILD
- Between waves, open the menu on your left hand and place walls, windows, barricades, floors, mines and turrets.
- Upgrade and repair with cash from kills, headshots and combos. Crime does not pay, but headshots do.
- Zombies smash whatever blocks their way, and when enough of them crowd a wall they climb over each other like a very rude human pyramid. Build high. Thin the pile.

SURVIVE
- Two levels, ten waves each, bosses who skipped leg day, and a gate to freedom.
- Exploders you should stop before they hug you, and spitters who never learned manners.
- Power-ups for health, speed and double cash, plus a reward box with a new weapon after every wave.
- A quick tutorial in its own training room, because nobody should meet their first zombie unprepared.

COMFORT
Smooth movement with an adjustable comfort vignette, snap or smooth turning, and settings for volume, gore and graphics.
nodes.short_description: A zombie wave shooter where you also build the walls. The zombies are red, the world is white, and your aim is about to be tested. Shoot, swing and punch through the horde, then place walls, turrets and mines between waves. Fair warning: zombies are terrible at architecture but great at teamwork. Leave enough of them at your wall and they will climb right over each other to say hello.

nodes.change_log: First Alpha build: tutorial training room, two levels, building phase, power-ups, bosses and the infamous zombie pile.
